correctness.rationale: The primal root-polytope is a two-opposite-face join; orthogonal section integration yields 2sqrt(N)/[(p-1)!(q-1)!] times integral A_(p-1)A_(q-1). For the polar |u_i-v_j|<=1, anchor minimum left value at zero, integrate left block max M with right interval length 2-M, and divide anchored volume by sqrt(N), giving 2^(N-1)p!q!/[sqrt(N)(N-1)!]. The density B_r=r A_(r-1)/2^(r-1) integrates to one; the known h-star identity also gives the finite sum. A_(r-1) is a polynomial with nonnegative coefficients in h=t(1-t), B_1=B_2=1, B_r strictly increasing for r>=3. Strict Chebyshev covariance gives R>1 iff p,q>=3 and MLR of successive B_r gives strict coordinatewise monotonicity. The B_q order-statistic mixture weakly concentrates at 1/2 as q diverges; the fixed-p limit and sqrt(min)-order growth bound follow by elementary concentration/Cauchy-Schwarz. Independently recomputed 64 exact beta-integral overlaps and the h-star finite sum for 1<=p,q<=8, applicable monotonic inequalities, and R(3,3)=81/80; no infinite claim inferred from those checks.
